findings.location: Decision item 6; relation statement at lines 44-45
findings.problem: “After an approval nothing is checked again” conflicts with accepted decision 2026-10-23-delegated-plan-approval item 9, which requires plan-status and the edit gate to re-check the current approve-plan delegation setting and withdraw a delegated approval when that setting no longer permits delegation. This record says it refines only items 2 and 4, so it leaves unclear whether item 9 still applies.
findings.suggestion: Limit item 6 to the new delegate-profiles/profile-match gate, and explicitly preserve the existing re-check of approve-plan’s current delegation level when a delegated approval is read.

summary: The post-approval rule conflicts with an accepted, supposedly unchanged rule for delegated approvals.
